title.zh-TW: /rewind 分頁工作階段可就地回溯
title.en: /rewind works in place for paged sessions

body.zh-TW: 對話拉長並切成好幾頁後，想往回退到前面某個步驟，往往得等整串紀錄重新讀取。現在輸入 `/rewind` 就能在分頁工作階段裡就地回溯，不會把每一輪對話全部重新載入。⟦看長片想倒帶重看某段時，以前拉回進度條得等整部片重新載入一遍，現在畫面會直接跳回那一秒。⟧
body.en: When a conversation grows long and splits across multiple pages, stepping back to an earlier point often meant waiting for the entire history to reload. Entering `/rewind` now rewinds in place within paged sessions without reloading every turn. ⟦Picture rewinding a long movie to rewatch a scene: dragging the slider back used to reload the whole film, whereas now the frame jumps straight to that second.⟧

items.original: `/rewind` now works in place for paged sessions without reloading every turn

title.zh-TW: /vim-mode all 開放完整 Vim 編輯

body.zh-TW:
習慣用 Vim 鍵位移動游標和改字的人，現在連代理人的輸入區都能全程套用。只要輸入 `/vim-mode all`，就能在代理人提示詞輸入框裡開啟完整的 Vim 編輯功能。

開啟後，鍵盤快捷鍵一覽表也會顯示 Vim Normal mode（只靠單鍵移動游標與改字的狀態）的獨立區塊。⟦開手排車上路時，以前進到市區還得切回自排，現在全程都能照手排檔位操作，旁邊還貼了一張檔位對照表。⟧
body.en:
Those used to moving the cursor and editing text with Vim keybindings can now use them all the way through the agent input area. Entering `/vim-mode all` turns on full Vim editing inside the agent prompt.

When enabled, Vim Normal mode (the state where single keys move the cursor and edit text) also appears as its own section in the keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet. ⟦Driving a stick shift used to mean switching back to automatic in city traffic, but now you can shift gears the whole trip with a gear chart taped right beside you.⟧

items.original:
`/vim-mode all` enables full Vim editing inside the agent prompt
Vim Normal mode now appears as a section in the keyboard shortcuts cheatsheet when enabled

title.zh-TW: 自動審查模式將整條提示列染成藍色
title.en: Auto-review mode tints the entire prompt bar blue

body.zh-TW: 在多種對話模式之間來回切換，靠顏色就能一眼分清目前處在哪一種。現在自動審查模式會把整條提示列染成藍色，跟規劃模式和提問模式的顯示方式一致。
body.en: When switching back and forth between conversation modes, color lets you tell at a glance which one is active. Auto-review mode now tints the entire prompt bar blue, matching how plan and ask modes appear.

items.original: Auto-review mode now tints the entire prompt bar blue, matching plan and ask modes

title.zh-TW: 提示詞佇列新增 WSL 切換與編輯標示
title.en: Prompt queue adds WSL toggle and editing label

body.zh-TW:
要把還沒送出的提示詞排成一列依序處理，現在連操作按鍵跟編輯標記都備齊了。在 Windows Terminal 裡透過 WSL（Windows 裡的 Linux 子系統）執行時，按 `Ctrl+Y` 就能切換提示詞佇列。

修改已經排進佇列的提示詞，那一列會變暗並顯示「editing」標籤。⟦在櫃檯拿叫號單排隊，想看清單按個鈕就叫得出來，臨時要改其中一單也會反灰標記，不會跟其他單混在一起。⟧
body.en:
Lining up unsent prompts to run in order now comes with both a toggle shortcut and an edit indicator. When running in WSL (the Linux subsystem on Windows) inside Windows Terminal, pressing `Ctrl+Y` toggles the prompt queue.

Editing a queued prompt dims the row and shows an "editing" label. ⟦Taking a numbered ticket at a counter lets you pull up the waitlist with one button, and updating a ticket grays it out so it never gets mixed up with the rest.⟧

items.original:
`Ctrl+Y` now toggles the prompt queue when running in WSL inside Windows Terminal
Editing a queued prompt now shows an "editing" label and dims the row

title.zh-TW: 輸入快捷鍵與啟動補全更順手
title.en: Smoother input shortcuts and startup completion

body.zh-TW:
在輸入框編輯草稿、叫出補全或貼上圖片，幾項按鍵行為與說明都跟著調整。

在精簡模式編輯草稿時，按 `Ctrl+E` 現在會把游標移到該行結尾。

剛啟動工具後，就算技能（預先寫好的擴充指令）還沒載入完成，`Tab` 鍵補全也能馬上使用。

針對 macOS 使用者，官方使用說明現在建議改用 `Ctrl+V` 來貼上螢幕截圖。
body.en:
Editing drafts, triggering completion, or pasting images in the input box gets a few updated key behaviors and docs.

When editing a draft in minimal mode, `Ctrl+E` now moves the cursor to the end of the line.

Right after startup, `Tab` completion works immediately even before skills (prewritten extension commands) finish loading.

For macOS users, the official documentation now recommends `Ctrl+V` to paste screenshots.

items.original:
`Ctrl+E` in minimal mode now moves the cursor to the end of line when editing a draft
macOS documentation now recommends `Ctrl+V` to paste screenshots
Tab completion now works immediately after startup even before skills load

title.zh-TW: 回覆區顯示與複製按鈕操作更正常
title.en: Cleaner reply rendering and clickable copy buttons

body.zh-TW:
查看 AI 產出的內容，裡頭常夾帶網址、程式碼、圖表和數學公式，這些元素的顯示與互動都有改善。 遇到打不開的網址時，畫面現在預設就會顯示連結卡片。 斜線選單或其他選單還開著的時候，程式碼區塊底下的複製按鈕依然可以直接點擊。 Mermaid（用文字語法畫流程圖的工具）圖表遇到 `\n` 和 `
` 時，現在會正確換行，不再把這幾個字元直接印出來。 Markdown 連結裡面如果夾帶 LaTeX（專門用來排數學公式的語法），現在會正常顯示為連結，不會誤判進入數學模式。
body.en:
Viewing AI output that mixes URLs, code, diagrams, and math formulas gets cleaner rendering and smoother interactions. Link cards now appear by default for links that cannot be opened. Copy buttons under code blocks remain clickable while slash or other menus are open. Mermaid (a tool for drawing flowcharts from text syntax) diagrams now break lines properly on `\n` and `
` instead of printing the literal characters. Markdown links containing LaTeX (syntax built for typesetting math formulas) now render as links instead of mistakenly entering math mode.

items.original:
Link cards now appear by default for links that cannot be opened Copy buttons under code blocks remain clickable while slash or other menus are open Mermaid diagrams now correctly break lines on `\n` and `
` instead of printing the literal characters Markdown links containing LaTeX now render correctly without entering math mode

title.zh-TW: 背景任務看得到數量且關閉畫面不誤停
title.en: Background task counts stay visible and safe on close

body.zh-TW:
讓指令或子代理（在背景分擔工作的助手）繼續執行時，最怕不清楚進度或手滑中斷。現在每輪對話結束的標記上，會直接顯示還有幾個背景指令正在跑。

如果不小心連點兩下關閉檢視畫面，也不會再把背景任務或子代理一起停掉。⟦廚房爐子上同時燉著幾鍋湯，計時器會清楚告訴你還有幾鍋在滾，不小心多按一次抽油煙機開關也不會把爐火一起關掉。⟧
body.en:
Leaving commands or subagents (helpers that split off work in the background) running makes it easy to lose track of progress or stop them by mistake. The end-of-turn marker now shows how many background commands are still running.

Double-clicking to close a view no longer accidentally stops a background task or subagent. ⟦Think of several pots simmering on a stove: a timer tells you how many are still bubbling, and hitting the range hood switch twice by mistake will not shut off the burners.⟧

items.original:
End-of-turn marker now shows how many background commands are still running
Double-clicking a view close no longer accidentally stops a background task or subagent

title.zh-TW: 已刪工作階段不重現且意見草稿可正常開啟
title.en: Deleted sessions stay hidden and feedback drafts open

body.zh-TW:
清理過往對話或回頭找草稿，工作階段相關的清單與紀錄現在都能正確對應。

已經刪除的工作階段，現在不會再出現在恢復清單或標題搜尋結果裡。

從完整工作階段檢視畫面開啟已儲存的意見回饋草稿，現在也能正常打開。
body.en:
Whether cleaning up past conversations or returning to a draft, session lists and records now line up properly.

Deleted sessions no longer appear in resume lists or title searches.

Saved feedback drafts now open properly from the full session view.

items.original:
Deleted sessions no longer appear in resume lists or title searches
Saved feedback drafts now open correctly from the full session view

title.zh-TW: 刪除與登入驗證的提示訊息顯示更完整
title.en: Clearer delete and sign-in authentication messages

body.zh-TW:
刪除操作失敗或碰到登入驗證問題，畫面上跳出的提示和狀態回饋不再讓人一頭霧水。

刪除操作失敗時的錯誤訊息，現在會顯示完整文字，不會被截斷。

登入期間若遇到驗證錯誤，訊息不會再把背後原因重複列出來。

複製 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）登入網址後的回饋提示，現在會正確標示驗證狀態。
body.en:
When a delete action fails or sign-in hits an authentication snag, the on-screen prompts and status feedback are no longer confusing.

Delete error messages now show their full text instead of being cut off.

Authentication error messages during sign-in no longer repeat the underlying cause.

Feedback after copying an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) sign-in URL now correctly indicates verification status.

items.original:
Delete error messages now show their full text instead of being cut off
Authentication error messages during sign-in no longer repeat the underlying cause
MCP sign-in URL copy feedback now correctly indicates verification status

title.zh-TW: tmux 延遲警告與終端機畫面穩定修復
title.en: tmux delay warning and terminal display fixes

body.zh-TW:
用 tmux（終端機多視窗管理工具）開多視窗，或是把終端機視窗縮得很矮，畫面跟按鍵檢查都有對應補強。

如果 tmux 扣住 `Esc` 鍵超過 50 ms，執行 `/doctor` 檢查時現在會跳出警告。

透過 8 色模式的 tmux 工作階段執行時，畫面上的文字現在會保持可見。

在高度非常矮的終端機上顯示取消本輪對話的提示，也不會再讓 TUI（終端機裡的文字操作介面）當掉。
body.en:
Running multiple panes with tmux (a terminal multiplexer for managing multiple panes) or shrinking the terminal window very short gets both key-check and display fixes.

`/doctor` now warns when tmux holds `Esc` for more than 50 ms.

Text remains visible when running through an 8-color tmux session.

Showing the cancel-turn prompt no longer crashes the TUI (text-based user interface inside the terminal) on very short terminals.

items.original:
`/doctor` now warns when tmux holds Esc for more than 50 ms
Text remains visible when running through an 8-color tmux session
Cancel-turn prompt no longer crashes the TUI on very short terminals
